Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular dishes menu, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/rasamandswad

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Rasam & Swad Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and a showcase of your authentic menu right on Exhibition Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain.
